json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Animals Killed: Total number of local passive or hostile wildlife creatures killed.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Armor Improved: Total number of armor pieces reinforced at a smithing workbench.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Armor Made: Total number of protective armor pieces crafted from scratch at a forge.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Assaults: Total recorded instances of initiating unprovoked violent combat against non-hostile citizens.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Automatons Killed: Total number of ancient Dwemer mechanical constructs dismantled.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Backstabs: Stealth sneak attacks executed from behind specifically utilizing one-handed daggers.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Barters: Total number of transaction buy/sell interactions made with merchants.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Books Read: Total number of unique books, journals, notes, and scrolls read.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Brawls Won: Total number of tavern fistfights and unarmed brawling encounters won.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Bribes: Successful speechcraft attempts to bribe guards or citizens with gold to get your way.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Bunnies Slaughtered: Total number of innocent woodland rabbits killed during your travels.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Chests Looted: Total number of treasure chests successfully opened and looted.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Civil War Quests Comp: Quests completed in the military campaigns for either the Imperial Legion or the Stormcloak Rebellion.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.College of Winterhold: Quests successfully completed for the magical academy of Winterhold.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Creatures Killed: Total number of magical beasts, monsters, and aggressive entities slain.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Critical Strikes: Total number of devastating critical combat strikes landed on opponents.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Daedra Killed: Total number of extra-planar Daedric entities banished or killed.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Daedric Quests Comple: Quests completed to satisfy or outsmart the whims of the Daedric Princes.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Dawnguard Quests Comp: Quests completed within the conflict between the Dawnguard faction and Lord Harkon's court.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Days Jailed: Total combined number of calendar days spent serving out criminal sentences behind bars.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Days Passed: The total number of in-game days that have passed during your journey in Tamriel.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Days as a Vampire: Total number of complete in-game days spent afflicted with the curse of Sanguinare Vampiris.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Days as a Werewolf: Total number of complete in-game days spent carrying the blood of the beast.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Diseases Contracted: Total number of times your character has been afflicted by a disease or blight.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Dragon Souls Collecte: Total number of ancient dragon essences absorbed upon slaying a Dovah.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Dragonborn Quests Com: Quests completed on the island of Solstheim dealing with the First Dragonborn, Miraak.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Dungeons Cleared: Number of dungeons and locations where the primary threat or boss has been entirely defeated.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Eastmarch Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Eastmarch (Windhelm).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Falkreath Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Falkreath Hold.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Fines Paid: Total amount of gold handed over to hold guards to settle legal debts and clear bounties.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Food Eaten: Total number of food items or cooked meals consumed.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Gold Found: Total amount of gold pieces looted, found in containers, or earned from exploration.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Haafingar Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Haafingar (Solitude).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Hjaalmarch Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Hjaalmarch (Morthal).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Horses Owned: Total number of horses legally purchased or acquired.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Horses Stolen: Total number of mounts ridden away without legal ownership or permission.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Hours Slept: Total cumulative hours spent sleeping in beds or bedrolls.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Hours Waiting: Total cumulative hours spent passing time via the wait menu.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Houses Owned: Total number of player properties purchased across the various holds.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Ingredients Eaten: Total number of raw alchemical components tasted directly to discover properties.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Ingredients Harvested: Total number of flora, fungi, and materials successfully collected from the environment.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Intimidations: Successful speechcraft attempts to coerce or force an NPC into compliance through threats.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Items Pickpocketed: Total individual items stolen directly off the persons of unsuspecting citizens.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Items Stolen: Total number of individual items illegally lifted from ownership containers or property.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Jail Escapes: Successful break-outs from confinement cells before your criminal sentence was served.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Largest Bounty: The single highest active criminal bounty price placed upon your head at one time.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Locations Discovered: Total number of map markers and unique locations discovered across Skyrim.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Locks Picked: Total number of locked doors, gates, and display cases successfully bypassed via lockpicking.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Magic Items Made: Total number of brand-new magical weapons or pieces of apparel created via Arcane Enchanters.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Main Quests Completed: Quests completed belonging to the primary storyline regarding the Dragonborn prophecy.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Mauls: Number of victims struck down or consumed while operating in werewolf form.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Misc Objectives Compl: Total number of minor tasks and miscellaneous journal objectives fulfilled.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Most Gold Carried: The highest amount of gold held simultaneously in your inventory at any point.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Murders: Total recorded instances of killing non-hostile citizens or innocent people.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Necks Bitten: Number of sleeping or seduced victims fed upon as a creature of the night.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Nirnroots Found: Total number of rare, luminescent, humming Nirnroot plants harvested.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.People Killed: Total number of civilized humanoids (men, elves, and beastfolk) slain by your hands.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Persuasions: Successful speechcraft attempts to persuade an NPC during conversation dialogues.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Pockets Picked: Total number of times an NPC's personal inventory was opened surreptitiously.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Poisons Mixed: Total number of toxic elements combined into offensive poisons.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Poisons Used: Total number of poison coatings applied to weapons or delivered to targets.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Potions Mixed: Total number of beneficial or curative concoctions brewed using alchemy labs.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Potions Used: Total number of alchemical potions drank.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Questlines Completed: Total number of major regional or faction story arcs brought to full completion.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Quests Completed: Total number of individual quests successfully finished.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Shouts Learned: Total number of unique multi-word Shouts discovered.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Shouts Mastered: Shouts where all three distinct Words of Power have been completely unlocked.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Shouts Unlocked: Total number of unique multi-word Shouts fully unlocked and ready to breathe.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Side Quests Completed: Standalone major quests completed outside of primary or faction story arcs.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Skill Books Read: Number of specialized books read that instantly granted a skill progression increase.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Skill Increases: Total number of times any of your core skills have leveled up.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Sneak Attacks: Total number of physical strikes executed while entirely undetected by your target.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Soul Gems Used: Total number of soul gems expended to recharge enchanted armaments or craft gear.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Souls Trapped: Total number of dying spirits successfully bound inside active inventory soul gems.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Spells Learned: Total number of unique magical incantations committed to memory from spell tomes.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Standing Stones Found: Number of ancient Standing Stones discovered throughout the province.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Stores Invested In: Number of shopkeepers and merchants you have financially supported with investment capital.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.The Companions Quests: Quests successfully completed for Whiterun's ancient order of warriors, The Companions.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.The Dark Brotherhood: Quests completed for Tamriel's notorious family of deadly assassins.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.The Pale Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of The Pale (Dawnstar).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.The Reach Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of The Reach (Markarth).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.The Rift Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of The Rift (Riften).
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Thieves' Guild Quests: Quests completed for the underground crime syndicate operating out of Riften.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Times Jailed: Total number of times arrested and processed into a hold's dungeon cells.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Times Shouted: Total count of times the Voice has been unleashed in Skyrim.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Total Lifetime Bounty: The total sum of all legal gold fines accumulated across every hold throughout your life.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Training Sessions: Total number of skill lessons purchased from professional trainers.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Trespasses: Total instances of entering restricted private zones or remaining inside properties past business hours.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Tribal Orcs Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the regional strongholds of the Orcish tribes.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Undead Killed: Total number of restless ghosts, draugr, skeletons, and vampires destroyed.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Vampirism Cures: Number of times you have successfully purged the vampire curse from your blood.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Weapons Disarmed: Number of times an enemy's active weapon was forcibly knocked from their grasp.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Weapons Improved: Total number of weapons sharpened and augmented using smithing grindstones.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Weapons Made: Total number of pristine weapons forged from raw materials at a blacksmith anvil.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Werewolf Transformati: Total number of times you have unleashed your inner beast and transformed into a werewolf.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Whiterun Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Whiterun Hold.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Wings Plucked: Total number of butterflies, moths, or insects caught for their wings.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Winterhold Bounty: Active criminal bounty debt accumulated within the jurisdiction of Winterhold.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Words of Power Learne: Individual words of the Thu'um located and transcribed from Word Walls.
json:menu_translation/statstracker/local.vanilla_stats_desc.Words of Power Unlock: Words of Power permanently activated utilizing collected dragon souls.
